newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC slightly revises down winter grain sowings.
newsitem.headline: ONIC slightly revises down winter grain sowings.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC said on Wednesday it had slightly revised down its estimate for 1997 winter grain sowings to 6.75 million hectares from a previous estimate of 6.76 million.
The new estimate brings sowings for winter grain to a level of 4.4 pct above last year's sowings.
ONIC had previously projected a 4.5 percent increase.
ONIC kept its estimate for winter soft wheat sowings unchanged at 4.98 million hectares.
This would bring 1997 winter soft wheat sowings up 4.7 pct over last year.
ONIC also held its estimate for winter durum wheat sowings to 273,000 hectares, up 1.5 percent over last year.
It put triticale sowings unchanged at around 200,000 hectares, up 0.6 percent over last year.
It projected oats sowings of 140,500 hectares, up 0.5 percent over last year.
ONIC gave the figures shortly after the farm ministry issued its own estimates.
The ministry predicted total winter grain area would rise by 3.4 percent to 6.630 million hectares, with winter soft wheat sowings rising 3.4 percent to 4.901 million hectares.
